name: seated short foot
description: Raising the arch by drawing the ball of the foot toward the heel, without curling the toes. It trains the small muscles that hold the arch up.
instructions: Sit with one bare foot flat on the floor, the knee over the ankle.
Keep the heel and the balls of the foot under the big toe and under the little toe on the floor.
Draw the ball of the foot toward the heel so the inner arch rises, without curling or lifting the toes.
Hold for 5 seconds, then relax the foot.
Once it is easy seated, do it standing, then on one leg.
